title: S0428 (2020 Regular): Prohibited Places for Weapons and Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-10-02; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2020/428/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 2055555))

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): (12)(a) A license issued under this section does not authorize any person to openly carry a handgun or carry a concealed weapon or firearm into:
Section 1 (s. 790.06, F.S.): 15. Any performing arts center or legitimate theater; or 16. Any place where the carrying of firearms is prohibited by federal law.
